title: Role-based Training
seo: AI training for sales, support and marketing
meta: Training shaped to one role, such as sales, support, marketing or operations, using real examples. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Role-based AI training for sales, support, marketing or operations
overview: A salesperson and a support agent need different skills. We build training for one role at a time, using the day to day tasks of that job, such as writing follow-ups, handling objections, answering tickets or planning campaigns. Each learner gets a short course of lessons with practice tasks and checklists, so they see their own work improve and can repeat it without us.

pkgs.blurb: A short course for one role, with practice tasks.
A fuller course for one role, with a live session.
Courses for up to three roles, with live sessions and guides.

faq: As written lessons and short exercises in a shared document or folder, plus live video sessions in the higher packages. Learners can go at their own pace.
Can you cover roles like finance or HR?
Yes, though sales, support, marketing and operations are the most common. Tell us the role and the tasks, and we confirm that AI can help with them safely.
We teach skills that work in most tools, then show how to apply them in the tool your team already has. We do not rely on one paid product.
How do we know it worked?
Each lesson ends with a task using real work, and the manager notes explain what good looks like. We cannot promise results, but progress is easy to see.
